- **Sub-tasks:**
  - [x] One shared migration runner: a long command timeout for the migration only, a wait for a database Master has not created yet, and a retry on a transient connection failure. Every startup migration goes through it.
  - [x] Remove `EnableRetryOnFailure` from `AdminDbContext` and `ContactsDbContext`.
  - [x] Master's startup makes the sample rows and their direct seed only; the HTTP fan-out stays in `SampleDataBootstrapWorker`, after Master listens.
  - [x] Docs and release notes.
  - [x] Test: written, never run by an AI (section 0.5).
  - [ ] Owner: pull, start **All APIs + Web App** against the remote database, and sign in. Run `Shared.Kernel.Tests` (`StartupMigrationTests`) and `Master.Api.Tests` (`SampleDataTests`).
- **Done when:** a start of everything against fresh databases has no service failing its migration, Master listens without waiting on other services, and login answers 200.
- **As built (Claude Opus 5.5, 10 October 2026):**
  - **`Shared.Kernel.Persistence.StartupMigration`.** It sets a ten-minute command timeout for the migration and puts the old one back afterwards. It waits up to ten minutes, every 5 s, for a missing database (3D000). It retries five times on a transient failure, and on a lost create race (42P04, 42P06, 42P07, 23505): EF creates a missing database itself, so a service can create `IN000001` while Master does. All 21 services' `DatabaseMigrationService`, Master's admin and per-tenant-schema migrations, the gateway and the notification migration go through it. Their own retry loops are gone: five tries two seconds apart, and Accounting's caught only 3D000.
  - **Master's `CREATE DATABASE`** treats 42P04 as done, for the same race.
  - **`EnableRetryOnFailure` removed** from Master's two contexts (`7bbcad37`), with a comment saying why. The connection string's `Timeout=60;Command Timeout=120` from the same commit stays.
  - **Sample data at startup.** `SampleDataRepository.EnsureRowsAsync` makes the customer, licence, branches, user and Owner roles without seeding. The startup job calls it in place of `EnsureAsync`, keeping its direct seed and its activation (`9800ffde`). The fan-out runs a minute after start in `SampleDataBootstrapWorker`, and both read the user through `SampleDataRepository.UserFrom(IConfiguration)`, falling back to `Bootstrap:Owner*`.
  - **Reproduced first, then checked here** against local PostgreSQL:
    - With `acc`'s history table locked for 50 s, Accounting.Api failed at 30,069 ms before the fix; after it, Accounting waited, migrated 45 tables and listened.
    - Master at `HEAD` made 76 failed seed calls before it listened. At about 2–4 s for each refused connection on Windows, that is the minutes of 502.
    - Login straight to Master returned 500 with *NpgsqlRetryingExecutionStrategy does not support user-initiated transactions*.
    - After the fix, three rounds of the gateway, Master and 13 services started together from dropped databases: 15 of 15 listened in about 30 s every time, and five 42P04 races were retried.
    - `POST /api/auth/login` through the gateway returned 200 with seven branches as Owner (the head office and the six sample branches); a wrong password returned 401.
  - **Not changed:** Master still migrates every tenant schema that the services also migrate. That second path is TK-183's to remove; this card makes the two safe to run together.

- **Verified by an AI (21 October 2026):** reproduced on `main` before the fix with the menu call held for four seconds: Accounts opened, then closed when the menu arrived. After the fix, every module on the rail passes both clicks (while loading, and after). Against a stub serving the real `MenuSeed.cs` tree, all 107 rows of the eight multi-screen modules open their own screen with the row, the rail item and the breadcrumb right, and the 27 earlier menu checks pass. Nothing posts one yet, so it is nothing until a manual journal does. **A foreign account's own-currency figures** use the Reconciliation Report's rule and leave a revaluation out. A credit card or overdraft is money held, so what is owed reads negative. Active accounts are always listed, inactive ones only with a balance, a posting in the period or by name. The page is at `/reports/bank-summary` ahead of `:reportKey`, opens on the financial year to date, has From, To and Bank account, one row for each account with its own-currency figures in smaller type under the base ones (a card on a phone), a totals row, the equation as a sentence, and the notes under the grid. A refused period clears the old result. The catalog source requires both dates through `TrialBalanceSourceRepository.PeriodOf`, takes its figures from `Figures` (two grouped queries put end to end and summed, then `posted.Concat(idle)`), and shows the bank account's own kind in its type column instead of the chart's type; its constructor lost the name resolver it no longer needs. Gateway route `reporting-statements-bank-summary`.

Totals 16,900, 11,200, 4,730, 130 and 23,500, and 16,900 + 11,200 − 4,730 + 130 = 23,500. **Every account's closing balance equalled the Reconciliation Report's `bookBalanceBase` for 31 October.** Three to five October gave HDFC 7,000, 5,000, 600 and 11,400, and November opened the USD account at 11,050 and USD 130 with no revaluation. Petty cash alone gave its own totals. No dates was 400 on both fields, an end before the start 400 on **To**, a bank account that is not the branch's 400 at its field, another branch 403, no **accounting.view** or only **reports.view** 403, and no token 401. The catalog source ran with the same six rows and totals, the revaluation column at 130, and refused a run without dates and with an end before the start (400, with the message). Nothing posts a revaluation yet, so it is queued as its own task.

(4) The unused `RouterLink` import of the Journal Report page, which warned on every web build, is removed in the same commit.

- **Rules:**
  - Receipts are `acc.ReceiveMoney` (posted); the documents settled come from `acc.TransactionRatios` where the receipt is the source.
  - `ReceiveMoneyRead.PaymentMethod` is `int` over a text column — TK-213 maps it.
  - A voided receipt is excluded, and so is a draft.
  - A receipt is in its own currency (amounts over its rate are base, as the ledger takes them); a receipt's lines settle what reached the bank *and* the TDS the customer withheld, so what it did not settle is both together less what it settled.
  - Sales has no debit note yet: the documents settled are the invoices (and whatever else a receipt was allocated to, such as an opening balance, by its code and id).
- **Sub-tasks:**

The catalog source takes none; its columns are itemCode, itemName, categoryName, quantity, grossAmount. Guard today: `sales.view`. Run against PostgreSQL it runs (200 on an empty branch).
- **What it answers:** What sold in a period, grouped by item, item category or customer: quantity, value, discount, net, cost and margin.
- **Benchmark:** Xero's *Sales by Item* / *Sales by Customer*; AutoCount's *Sales Analysis by Item/Customer*; Odoo's *Sales Analysis* pivot.
- **Filters:**
  - **From** and **To** dates, both required (D-67); the page opens on the financial year to date (`rangeForPreset('this-financial-year')` to today); To before From is a field error on **To** (invoice date)
  - **Group by** item, category or customer (required, item by default)
  - **Customer**, **Item category**, **Warehouse** (optional)
  - **Include credit notes** (on by default: returns reduce the figures)
- **Layout:** One grid: per group the quantity, gross value, discount, net value, cost of sales, margin and margin %; totals row; a compare-period option as on the P&L; 360px cards.
- **Rules:**
  - Posted invoices (and POS sales, `TransactionTypeCode = 'POS'`) less posted credit notes.
  - Cost of sales from the costed stock movements (`inv.StockMovements` / cost layers) for those lines; a line not yet costed (`CostingStatus` not `Costed`) shows its cost as pending, not zero (CLAUDE.md, Inventory & costing).
  - Net sales in base currency, before tax: the line's taxable value, after discount. Gross and discount are as keyed, so a price that includes tax shows it in gross.
  - A line's cost is found by its document's type, id and line id on the stock movement (how Sales records an issue and a return); a movement that is pending, in progress or failed makes the line *pending*, and a group or total with a pending line has **no margin** rather than an overstated one. A line with no movement costs nothing and is not pending.
  - A credit note takes units off only when it is a sales return (the only reason that moves stock); a price correction or a discount takes net sales off and no units. The compare period is a second pair of dates (both or neither) and compares **net sales** only.

A document counts when it is created, drafts and voided included, on the IST calendar month of its creation. Delivery challans do not count. A conversion counts as the new document it creates. Recurring billing skips and logs a document once the limit is reached. Sales and Purchase are counted apart. TK-210 |
| D-70 | What does "Upgrade to Elite" do, with no payment system in the app? | TK-209, TK-211 | **Send a request** (owner, 2026-10-21): the request is recorded (`mst.UpgradeRequests`) and emailed to a configured address, and a platform operator switches the plan from the admin screens. No payment is taken in the app; a self-service checkout would need a payment provider, which has not been chosen. TK-209, TK-211 |
| D-71 | Where do the Plan screen's prices come from? | TK-211 | **A server price table** (owner, 2026-10-21): Quarterly and Bi-Annual prices per business type in `mst.PlanPrices`, seeded from the website's monthly prices; Elite is three times Professional's, and an operator can change a price without a release. TK-211 |

## 5. Standard delivery sub-tasks (feature cards)

Copy these into any card that builds a feature, and tick them as you go:

- [ ] Entity in `{Module}.Entity/TableEntities`, inheriting `AuditableEntity`, with an
      `ErrorMessage` on every annotation. Enums in `Enums/`.
- [ ] `DbSet` and Fluent config. `CustomerId` + `OrgId` and the query filter; `xmin` concurrency.
- [ ] The migration, with an RLS `ENABLE` + `FORCE` + policy block in it (the TK-71 template).
      Run `dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes`.
- [ ] Seed data that is idempotent when a branch is created.
- [ ] Service and controller. Writes happen inside the reliability filter's transaction
      (`BeginScopeAsync`, never `BeginTransactionAsync`). Errors go through `SqlErrorCatalog`. The
      controller carries a guard attribute. A request for another branch's data gets `Forbid()`.
- [ ] `-core` view-model and `-ui` page: standalone components, `inject()`, signals, working at 360px.
- [ ] Write the tests: behaviour, the **Done when** line, and the `RlsAudit` and `EndpointGuardAudit`
      tests for the new schema and controllers. An AI writes them and does not run them (section 0.5).
- [ ] Update the docs page under `docs/User_Guide/` and `docs.manifest.ts`, and add a
      `release-notes.md` bullet under **Unreleased**, all in the same commit.
- [ ] `dotnet build` in `backend/`, and `npm run lint`, the typecheck and the builds in `frontend/`, are
      all clean. Running the tests (`dotnet test`, `npm run test`) is the owner's step (section 0.5).
